tasks.personal-social-wellbeing-t3: Topic: Personal and Social Well-being. Cover diversity, culture, religion, rights and responsibilities, and substance abuse awareness. Ask learners to identify respectful actions, match rights to responsibilities, explain why stereotypes are harmful, recognise healthy responses to peer pressure, and choose safe actions that protect individuals and communities.
tasks.physical-education-t3: Topic: Physical Education. Cover athletics, relays, indigenous games, flexibility, and reaction time. Ask learners to identify safe warm-up and cool-down habits, recognise correct relay and jumping technique, explain teamwork and fair play, and choose actions that improve flexibility, coordination, and quick response in movement activities.
tasks.creative-arts-t3: Topic: Creative Arts. Cover South African cultural art, mixed media, choral verse, singing, and movement. Ask learners to identify respectful use of cultural themes, recognise mixed-media materials and texture, and answer questions about rehearsal, timing, expression, and group performance in integrated creative activities.
